chunks: Those who will be pushed faces forward into Hell will be in a worse position, farther away from the path.

key_terms.يُحْشَرُونَ: They will be gathered or assembled (on the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that disbelievers will be gathered into Hell with their faces forward?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate humiliation of the disbelievers, whose faces being dragged signifies their loss of dignity and the haste with which they are cast into the Fire. It contrasts their 'worse location' (sharr makanan) with the elevated status of the believers, emphasizing that their deviation is not merely spatial but spiritual, leading them further astray from the straight path.
